_comment: Claude Desktop config for connecting to a running CEGM broker.
Two variants below — pick one and remove the other. The HTTP variant
is preferred because it does not require Claude Desktop to spawn the
broker; the broker is already running once Cheat Engine is open.

cegm-http._comment: Preferred. Requires Cheat Engine + CEGM plugin running so the broker is live on 127.0.0.1:27077.

cegm-stdio-fallback._comment: Use only if HTTP is unavailable. Spawns its own broker (will not connect to a CE that is already running).
